title: Seriously Clear Sour Blue Dust 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Seriously Clear Sour Blue Dust delivers an intensely sharp and sweet profile that focuses on a classic vaping favourite. The inhale provides the distinct, sugary taste of vibrant Blue Raspberry, which is immediately followed by a sharp, sour kick on the exhale. This extra-concentrated formulation ensures that the contrast between the sweet, confectionery-inspired notes and the tart edge remains distinct and consistent from the first puff to the last. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter kits. The premium nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a highly effective option for everyday use. For the best performance and clear flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm. The Seriously Clear collection by the acclaimed UK mixologists at Doozy Vape Co. and Crystal Clear offers a premium range of double-concentrated "bar salt" e-liquids. Designed to provide maximum flavour intensity with a remarkably clean finish, this line focuses on sharp, vibrant fruit and sour profiles. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, this e-liquid is available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, providing a versatile and satisfying choice for your refillable device.
